signs.Aries: Today brings with it the possibility of a new kind of relationship. You may have been through quite a time in terms of partnerships and would now like the situation to settle down and become more stable. However, you don't want to settle for second best, and so would benefit by developing a new set of friendships that reflect your changing ideals.
signs.Taurus: You tend to get stuck in a routine, and this can often be a problem when you wish to move on and do something different. Consider some new and very different options in order to exercise your imagination. Rather than banish these fruitful ideas about a new life and wonderful partnership, why not spend some time considering if they might work?
signs.Gemini: You may feel the urge to explore new areas of a personal relationship. You have gotten used to a certain pattern of behavior and find it difficult to consider any other way of being with your partner (current or prospective). However, if you extend your thoughts a little and start to consider the possibility of a new direction, then you may equally feel like making it work.
signs.Cancer: Love is about considering some new options today. Life is a process of constant change; nothing can remain the same. And so, with love, which needs room to expand and allow each person to grow and develop into the being they truly are. Take time to consider whether you and a loved one are enjoying such a process of continuous and positive development.
signs.Leo: There is a truly adventurous atmosphere in the air. If you are looking for a different kind of romance from the usual sentimental kind, then it may be a good idea to join a group of people who have the same aims. This will ensure that you draw to yourself friends of a like mind and similar nature.
signs.Virgo: The atmosphere of the day encourages growth, and also a sense of moving on, of leaving the past behind, and moving boldly into a new and more brilliant future. It is a great opportunity to take up a new direction, and to decide what you would like to do with your life, and the kind of relationships you would like to enjoy from now on.
signs.Libra: You may be tempted to get off the fence, as the option before you is so truly exciting that you just cannot resist it. A certain person, who may have been a close friend, could reveal their real feelings for you, and you will be bowled over. The path ahead suddenly seems to sparkle in a way that it never did before.
signs.Scorpio: You and your partner (current or prospective) are coming closer together. This is a great chance to air and share your feelings, to rekindle the spark that may have become a little dim recently, and to spend some quality time together. Make the most of this opportunity, and you will deepen your bond and commitment considerably. Give each other some space and a chance to shine.
signs.Sagittarius: The planets are working together to create a deep sense of passion, and an urge to own or possess a loved one. Your partner (current or prospective) may find this objectionable, which could create a block in communication. If you want to improve matters, then try to let go. As long as you hang on so tightly, they will resist your advances.
signs.Capricorn: You may try and go too far too fast today, given the energy boost you'll have been on the receiving end of. A particular person who you have been trying to charm for some time may find you way too overpowering and develop a decided urge to run for it. If you want to give the relationship any chance, then back off. Give them a little space to decide in your favor.
signs.Aquarius: You may experience a great deal of abject moodiness, and not much happiness when it comes to your current relationship. You have every chance of enjoying yourself if you can draw your partner (current or prospective) out of their deeply pensive and introspective mood and get them to participate in some way. It may seem, however, that they are determined to do the opposite of everything you want to do.
signs.Pisces: If it’s possible to go out on a first date, then you can expect this to be a very special kind of evening. There is an electric intensity and passion in the air, and the two of you may find that you get on with each other better than you had thought possible. What happens from here could be truly amazing, if you have the courage to pursue it.
